issues.issue: Could be motor vehicle tax (county-distributed motor vehicle tax) rather than pro-rate state aid; the label is ambiguous. Same for detail[2] and detail[17] (detail_category 'motor vehicle pro-rate').

The rules put fees under debt service interest ('including fees'), and SID 241/244 used debt service interest for fiscal/paying agent fees. detail[5] (General Fund Fiscal Agent Fees 11,200) is general government / professional/contract services as well.
This is a bond-related cost in the Debt Service Fund, so debt service interest (fees) may fit better.

issues.on_page: Change in Payables 2,700 (Other Financing Sources, Total column)
issues.issue: The amount is correct as printed under Other Financing Sources. But a change in payables is an accrual adjustment, not a financing source, so it may belong in adjustments[]. The identity holds either way.
